title: 3.0rc1 SMB disabled
body:
Hello,

perhaps a new feature or possible a bug. I don‘t use my 3.0rc1 version for active looping. So I don‘t know, if the SMBs are disabled in 3.0rc1 or earlier in one of the beta versions.
When I started testing the 3.0 versions with beta1, then the SMBs are working.
But today, I saw this message (see picture). SMBs are enabled in the configuration.
I use xDrip+ (slave) for generating the glucose values on my AAPS3.0 test system.
Kind regards
![7D632E63-DD92-455E-8CCA-E0723C57B422](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6819067/149363113-e762abf4-039b-405f-8e72-e86cade48d3c.png)

comments.body: what is on the top of this tab?
Do you have Red warning sign on the main screen regarding the BG readings?

On my master system: xDrip+ with Dexcom G6 Native mode, xDrip+ master for followers. On my test system with AAPS 3.0: xDrip+ Sync Follower.
There is no red warning sign on the main screen of my AAPS3.0 test system.
can you print screen your SMB preferences?

hmmm seems to be ok
then provide logs pls
max minutes of basal to limit smb to 120 is very high,limit to max 90 for test.
always to test : set safety multiplier to 5  both options and maximum total IOB to 25U.
The mail address in AAPS 3.0 „SEND LOGS BY EMAIL“ xxx@androidaps.org can‘t be reached. The domain androidaps.org doesn‘t exist.
From what I see you are using BG source not supporting SMB always and you don't enter carbs. Thus COB is always zero and SMB is forced disabled

Yes, that‘s already mentioned in the Constraints Part of the „OPENAPS SMB“ section. But when xDrip+ Sync Follower isn‘t allowed as BG source, then I can‘t test AAPS 3.0 on my test system anymore. The option to set a second G6 is possible, but then, I have to wear a lot of additional stuff close to me. Using it as active loops system is not my favorite.
